title: Furthering Equity Through Infant Feeding EDucation and Support
official: Clinically Integrated Breastfeeding Peer Counseling to Promote Breastfeeding Equity
summary: The purpose of this study is to identify whether adding clinically integrated breastfeeding peer counseling (ci-BPC) to standard lactation care is associated with a reduction in disparities in breastfeeding intensity and duration for Black and Hispanic/Latine families.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 12 and 24 weeks gestation
* English or Spanish speaking
* Planning to parent their infant
* Planning to deliver at SH, HPH or UCM
* No prior exposure to ci-BPC

Exclusion Criteria:

* considering pregnancy termination or adoption
* Prior exposure to ci-BPC
